analysis_unit: H × 區段口徑 × 成本 × 訊號日期 × 市場
notes: The prior v4.85.1 and v4.85.3 results pooled two distinct 区段口徑 values. This v4.85.4 re-runs all cross-sectional tests separately by scope.
Only 前10名候選逐檔評估 with included, valid-entry, valid-exit, nonmissing realized net returns are analyzed.
General and stress costs are analyzed separately; paired differences use scope-specific date-market cells.
Rank scores are reversed so positive effect means smaller, better numeric rank group outperforms larger rank group.
Spearman FDR is corrected separately within each H × scope × cost family across 20 stock feature/model score fields.
Monthly moving-block bootstrap tests temporal stability; it is not a causal test or live deployment evidence.
